gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-noticia-text: Shantell Sans has a hand-drawn, marker-pen looseness, every stroke the same width and every opening gaping wide. Noticia Text, a classic serif, brings the most to the pair with its tall lowercase and generous entry curves, giving the loose heading a dignified partner.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-piazzolla: Shantell Sans draws its rounded, wide-mouthed letters with one fixed nib, and it is at its best making a loud, friendly first impression. Piazzolla, a serif with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, does the opposite job, sounding authoritative once you settle in.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-pridi: A single fixed nib width and wide-open mouths give Shantell Sans its marker-drawn personality, which is what it does best. Pridi, a serif with proud, nearly capital-sized small letters, is better at quiet refinement and spacious curves.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-scope-one: Shantell Sans loops out wide-mouthed letters with the same nib width throughout, while its partner gets stubby ascenders and a big x-height. Scope One, a serif, spills its counters outward, so paragraphs feel traditional and refined.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, with big open counters in its a, e and s. Against the pipe-cleaner strokes of Shantell Sans, nudge the size of this classic serif up a little so those openings have room to breathe.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-suwannaphum: Loose and chalky meets sturdy and tall: Shantell Sans draws wide-mouthed curves without any swelling at the stems, set against a serif with an x-height like a woodblock. Suwannaphum carries a dignified, editorial voice with a paperclip-open c.
gen-gf-simonetta-fs-rowan: Simonetta is bold and commanding, with quiet stroke contrast, snugged pairs and wide-set curve ends in every round. Rowan, a text serif, adds friendly, literary warmth through generous curve openings, though it was not meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-sirin-stencil-fs-karma: Karma, a classic serif, finishes its terminals well clear of the stem and thickens and thins in gentle steps, so the lines never snag the eye. Sirin Stencil's drilled-bead counters and single-stylus strokes make it the loud sibling.
gen-gf-sirin-stencil-fs-paquito: Sirin Stencil traces every stroke at one ruler-straight width, with huge bead-like counters. Paquito, a serif with almost no gap between x-height and caps, feels confident and approachable beside it, good for a handful of lines.
gen-gf-slackey-fs-karma: Slackey stands tall and sturdy in its lowercase, with long pauses between letters and horizontals a notch lighter than the uprights. Karma, a text serif, holds back with trustworthy, classic restraint, since the heading is made to grab attention and this one to stay readable.
